title: Accessibility
label: A11Y

rows.text: The switches are below the screen.

rows: A plain, high-contrast reader view of every page. Your choice is remembered.
Number keys, R, G, Y and B jump between pages; H holds a cycling page. Turn them off if they get in the way of speech input.
Scanlines and glow, like an old TV. Off at first if your system asks for less motion or more contrast.
